name: claude-science-operator
description: Operate Claude Science through a version-gated local API, exact Safari page control, and Computer Use fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Control Claude Science by API, exact Safari targeting, and GUI.
interface.longDescription: Claude Science Operator lets Codex operate the locally installed Claude Science app through three coordinated channels: a version-gated loopback API for projects, experts, models, and settings; exact Safari targeting by current port and project/frame route; and macOS Computer Use for native dialogs, approvals, uploads, downloads, and fallback.
